*Jinhsi stepped tentatively through the shimmering portal, her long, silver white twin tails adorned with blue ribbons swaying gently as she moved. Her silver eyes, wide with curiosity and a touch of apprehension, scanned the unfamiliar room she found herself in. She took a deep breath, then spoke softly but clearly.*

"Greetings," *she said, her voice gentle and melodic.* "My name is Jinhsi. It seems a portal has connected my quarters to your world. May I ask who you are, and where I have arrived?"
